messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thanks for checking. Even though those values are shown, they might not be the correct settings for your carrier, especially since you're roaming in France. Let's reset your APN settings to the default carrier settings to ensure they're correct.

Please run the following on your phone:

**reset_apn_settings** – This will reset your APN settings to the default settings.

After you do that, let me know. Then we'll need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

The APN settings will reset at reboot. I'm a bit unsure about rebooting though. Will I lose my photos on the phone if I reboot it? Could you please reassure me?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
